objective: Repeat the exact ten-frame sequence already proven by OPENDITOO-M8-FINITE-LOOP-001. Adds reproducibility of the accepted rate, and a second independent sample of the ACK payload sequence to test the standing LEAD that it is a counter or time-derived value.
why_this_is_the_cheap_path: Nothing new is attempted: same frames, same rate, same budgets, same session shape. The only reason this is a separate manifest rather than a re-run of 001 is that 001's authority was consumed by its execution, and un-consuming it would destroy the record of what actually happened.

target.pairing_precheck: authenticated exact target required before any socket is created

transport.one_controller_rule: the Android app must be disconnected for the whole run

operation.shape: one connection; ten frames alternating A,B,A,B,... ; per frame send preamble A, preamble B, image, read one ACK, wait the inter-frame delay; then close
operation.semantic_evidence: OPENDITOO-M8-FINITE-LOOP-001 PASS on 2026-09-09: ten frames in one connection, 30/30 packets, 710/710 bytes, 10/10 ACKs, no retry, no reconnect, clean close in 10.26 s, ACK latency 102-124 ms with no drift.

source_frames.why_reuse: The A/B frames are already frozen and already physically proven in step 1, so this experiment changes exactly one variable: repetition. Introducing new artwork at the same time would confound the measurement.

measurements_required: actual achieved inter-frame interval versus the requested one
any frame whose ACK did not arrive
any stock page takeover or visible interruption during the run

budgets.derivation: Same 1000 ms inter-frame delay proven in step 1 and equal to the stock median. The rate is deliberately NOT increased in this experiment: the only new variable is repetition. Ten frames is the smallest count that shows sustained behaviour rather than a one-off. Wall clock is roughly 3x the expected ~12 s.

expected_observations.transport: one connection, thirty application packets, ten wrapped 0x44 ACKs, clean local close
expected_observations.physical: the white block alternates between the top-left and bottom-right corners ten times, ending in the bottom-right
expected_observations.ack_payload: recorded per frame, not asserted. Run 001 produced ten distinct payloads strictly increasing modulo 256 with deltas 0x51-0x6A. A second sample tests whether that pattern reproduces.

persistence_analysis.basis: M6.4 power cycle returned the unit to stock software and the default clock
persistence_analysis.not_claimed: absence of any non-volatile write; repetition does not test that either
persistence_analysis.new_persistence_risk_vs_step_1: none identified: identical command, identical packets, same session shape, repeated. No new command id, no save/publish/upload, no gallery interaction.

stop_immediately_on: unexpected target identity or pairing precheck failure
any ACK that is not exactly one 10-byte wrapped 0x44 frame
any send that does not complete in full
any conflicting controller observed on the link
a stock page takeover or any device behaviour outside the expected observations
stop_policy.on_ambiguous_outcome: stop, preserve the Host diagnostics record including the per-frame timings collected so far, and report. Do NOT resend, do not reconnect, do not power-cycle before the result is recorded.
stop_policy.recovery: operator-initiated only, after the outcome is recorded
stop_policy.operator_abort: the run is short enough to watch end to end; if it looks wrong, power off the Ditoo rather than letting it continue.

implementation_gate.host_change_required: none; the Host already supports this exact shape
implementation_gate.status: already implemented and deployed under the 001 grant

authority.grant_text: can u make em bounce once more
authority.grant_scope: this exact experiment id, one execution of the same ten-frame sequence at the same budgets. Not continuous display, not a higher rate, not M9 activation.
authority.note: A repeat of an already-proven bounded operation, explicitly requested by the operator. It re-uses 001's reviewed shape unchanged; nothing about the packets, rate or budgets differs.

explicitly_out_of_scope: any rate above the 1000 ms inter-frame delay
driving frames from the M9 activity collector
keeping the connection open beyond this run

measurements.reproducibility: The accepted ceiling reproduces. Run 001 elapsed 10259 ms, run 002 elapsed 10257 ms; mean inter-ACK interval 1116.2 ms and 1114.1 ms; median ACK latency 105 ms in both. Zero missing ACKs and zero errors in both.

findings.statement: Across both ten-frame runs (18 intervals) the ACK payload is strictly increasing modulo 256 with a variable increment of 77-109, mean ~92. A simple elapsed-time derivation is RULED OUT: the inter-ACK interval varied by only about 3 percent (1103-1138 ms) while the increment varied by about 35 percent. If the byte were interval divided by the implied ~12.13 ms per unit, the increments would have spanned roughly 91-94, not 77-109. Measured correlation between interval and increment is r=0.066 over n=18.
findings.also_observed: The first ACK of each session differed (0x86 in run 001, 0x06 in run 002), so the value is not reset to a fixed baseline per connection and behaves like something free-running on the device.
findings.not_claimed: What the byte actually is. A counter advanced by device-internal activity, a content-dependent value, and a checksum-like value all remain open. No further probing was done and none is proposed: nothing in the product depends on this byte, and the CLI already refuses to validate it.
